name: DUDE
intro: DUDE（Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation）旨在重新评估文档AI领域当前的方法论，并推动创建更具实践导向的基准。该基准通过引入基于多行业、多领域、多页视觉丰富文档（VRDs）的新型问题、答案和文档布局，以解决视觉丰富文档理解研究进展停滞的问题。DUDE致力于通过多任务和多领域评估设置来更准确地模拟现实世界情况，以促进在低资源设置下的强大泛化和适应能力。
org: KU Leuven, Contract.fit, Snowflake, CVC-UAB, University of La Rochelle, Instabase
build_method: 公共文档人工检索, 多阶段众包标注, 语言学专家仲裁, 诊断标签
modality: 文档图像, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 多行业, 多领域, 多页, 多任务, 泛化能力, 适应性
scale: 论文表1：5,019份源文档/41,541道标注输出题；表2：4,974份/41,491题；固定v1.0.8产物：5,017个唯一docId/41,456标注行/41,453个唯一questionId（3个重复）
build_method_en: Manual public-document search, phased crowd annotation, linguist adjudication, diagnostic labeling
eval_feature_en: Multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page, multi-task, generalization ability, adaptability
intro_en: DUDE (Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation) aims to reassess current methodologies in the document AI field and promote the creation of more practical benchmarks. It addresses the stagnation in visual-rich document (VRD) understanding research by introducing new questions, answers, and document layouts based on multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page VRDs. DUDE strives to more accurately simulate real-world scenarios through multi-task and multi-domain evaluation settings, fostering robust generalization and adaptability in low-resource environments.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with DUDE arXiv:2305.08455v3 Sections 3.1–3.5 and Appendix B.4, official Hugging Face DUDE_loader revision b3662175d3b2482d711f18559b7acc2a5bccc600 (loader code v1.0.7), and its Zenodo 7763635 annotation artifact dataset_version v1.0.8 (MD5 bf252b2dc57d501b2d3110a4e7e6e9c5; SHA256 4f883956ba02cb676022ec24878cdc415e759438e945c2d479bdae488873e2e8). Count boundaries are explicit: paper Table 1 has 5,019 source documents and reports 41,541 questions at the annotation output; paper Table 2 totals 4,974 documents and 41,491 questions; the pinned v1.0.8 annotation contains 5,017 unique docIds, 41,456 annotation rows, and 41,453 unique questionIds, including 3 duplicate questionId occurrences. Phase 1 covers extractive, abstractive, list, evidence-box, and non-answerable annotation; non-answerable questions are predominantly authored by linguists and bypass Phases 2–3, while high inter-answer ANLS completes Phase 2 and bypasses only Phase 3. Optional Phase 4 is a pre-release branch from the paper split accounting: experts review and correct hidden-test QA over 530 documents and 2,462 questions, add diagnostic metadata, and rejoin at the pinned annotation artifact; it is not on the mandatory split-to-artifact mainline. Threshold boundaries are kept separate: paper Section 3.5 defines ECE correctness as ANLS > 0.5; Appendix Equation 3 retains each answer-pair NLS when NLS >= 0.5; fixed DUDEeval revision 8bd6deac0f9747e344338e3850f02bf76744d888 implements ECE correctness as ANLS >= 0.5. That commit implements Hungarian order-invariant list matching and up to 100 equal-mass ECE bins with L1 distance, falling back to equal-range bins for constant confidence; AURC is described in the paper but absent from the pinned evaluator commit.
